title: The Vigil
text: Pilgrims keep an all-night vigil at a roadside altar, kneeling in a ring of candles, swaying and murmuring with eyes that never close. They invite you to join them. Some have knelt so long that their knees have bled into the stone.

options.label: Kneel and keep the vigil, as the pilgrims do.

outcomes.text: After a long night comes a clear morning, though their legs are too stiff to hurry.

options.label: Sleep instead; the road needs you rested more than the altar needs you kneeling.

outcomes.text: You rest while the murmuring goes on all night around you.
